name: grigori_adept
description: a Grigori Adept, a young mage: tousled brown hair under a pointed teal hood, a teal scarf wound round the neck, a long teal coat, a brown leather vest crossed by brown belts and straps with a brass buckle, a brown leather satchel stuffed with scrolls hanging at his screen-left hip, brown boots, and a wooden staff topped with a glowing pale-blue crystal in his LEFT hand
hands: the crystal-topped staff stays upright in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side is an empty fist resting on the satchel strap

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (his empty right fist flung out to the left, the crystal-topped staff thrown up and out in his left hand), the teal hood jolting back
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the crystal-topped staff tilting out to the right, his empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the crystal-topped staff high, his empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops inside the teal hood, the crystal-topped staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the crystal end of the staff resting on the ground at the lower-right, his empty right hand hanging by the satchel
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the crystal-topped staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the long teal coat flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the teal hood under his head; the crystal-topped staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the satchel of scrolls lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the teal hood, scarf and coat settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the crystal-topped staff on the ground beside him, its crystal dim
